card.capacity_status_quote: Manufacturing lead times are now about a year, and so most of the purchase orders are being placed a year in advance.
card.demand_direction_quote: During fiscal Q3 2026, revenue was $3.3 billion, up 45% year over year, driven by strong demand across all our end markets and an improved pricing environment.
card.pricing_power_quote: Pricing was up 9% year over year.
card.guidance_direction_quote: As we continue to operate in a strong demand and pricing environment, with longer-term visibility across our cloud, consumer, and client businesses, we anticipate revenue to be $3.65 billion, plus or minus $100 million. At midpoint, this reflects growth of 40% year over year.
card.constraint_owner_quote: The LTA volume we put together for our customers does not meet their full requirement, and anything we deliver above and beyond the base volume requirement we have agreed is subject to a different pricing regime that gives us an opportunity to drive some incremental upside.
